summary.whatChanges: Adds `maxWorkers` to the list of CLI options that override per-project config in Vitest, so `--maxWorkers` now propagates to every project instead of being ignored. Adds an e2e test for it, and updates the merge-reports snapshot to a different project/test ordering.
behaviorChanges: Running `vitest --maxWorkers=N` now sets maxWorkers on each resolved project, overriding project-level config
Project configs that define their own maxWorkers are overridden when the CLI flag is passed
Merge-reports reporter output snapshot now lists browser project results before node project results (linux/macos grouping order changed)
risks: Projects that intentionally set a different maxWorkers will silently have it overridden by the CLI flag, possibly changing concurrency/resource use
The merge-reports snapshot reordering is not explained by any source change in this diff, suggesting ordering may be nondeterministic and the test could be flaky
